description: Nestlé Pakistan Limited is a food and beverages company that has operated in Pakistan since 1988, initially under a joint venture with Milk Pak Ltd and taking over management in 1992. It describes itself as the country's leading food and beverages company, with a focus on nutrition, health and wellness, and distributes nationally from factories at Sheikhupura, Kabirwala, Islamabad and Port Qasim.
headOffice: Packages Mall, Shahrah-e-Roomi, PO Amer Sidhu, Lahore 54760, Pakistan

products.name: NESTLÉ MILKPAK
products.summary: The company's full cream UHT milk brand, which it describes as drawing on over three and a half decades of dairy expertise in Pakistan.

products.name: NESTLÉ MILKPAK Hi-Calcium Low Fat
products.summary: A high-calcium, low-fat UHT milk, presented on the company's site under the former NESVITA name, with less than 1% fat.

products.name: NESCAFÉ
products.summary: The company's coffee brand, sold in Pakistan including ready-to-drink chilled variants.

products.name: NESTLÉ PURE LIFE
products.summary: The company's bottled water brand, which Nestlé Pakistan notes was first launched in Pakistan in 1998.

products.name: NESTLÉ CERELAC
